w10_P4_001761: The figure at the end of a hydraulic-press test sheet, in kN, is a 2 kN gauge offset added to a combined thrust that is expressed in kN. The combined thrust is that of 10 identical rams acting together. Each ram supplies the force needed to accelerate a 26 kg tool head at a rate in m/s² equal to 12 times the larger root of x² - 11x + 30 = 0. What figure ends the test sheet, in kN?
w10_P4_001764: A 27 kg test drone on a runway sled reaches a speed in m/s equal to 27 more than 5 times the sum of 4 and 1. Its energy of motion is measured, and 9 J of sensor bias is added. The result is converted to kJ. The runway is 800 m long. Eight identical drones are tested in the batch, so the batch figure is 8 times the single-drone value. What is the batch figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001772: A rider and bike with a combined mass of 46,000 g move at a speed in m/s equal to 5 times the smaller root of x² - 9x + 18 = 0. The energy of motion is converted to kJ. The ride took 25 minutes. A relay team has 3 such riders, and the club fields 4 teams, so the club figure is the single-rider value multiplied by 3 and then by 4. What is the club figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001773: A 55,000 g projectile on a test catapult is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to 6 times the sum of 8 and 5. The catapult arm must supply the force needed for this, plus 25 N to overcome pivot friction. The range has 3 arms per catapult, 5 catapults per bay, and 6 bays. The range total is therefore the per-arm value multiplied by 3, then by 5, then by 6. What is the range total, in N?
w10_P4_001775: A 130 kg engine block on a hoist is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the larger root of x² - 3x + 2 = 0. The hoist must supply the force for this plus 23 N of chain drag. The hoist's chain is 8 m long. The total is converted to kN, and 27 kN of structural allowance is added. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_001785: A 112 kg sled on a rocket test track is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to 2 times the sum of 7 and 9. The thrust needed for this is reduced by 19 N of aerodynamic assist from a tailwind, then increased by 8 N of rail friction. The track is 1.5 km long. Eleven sleds run in the campaign, so the campaign total is 11 times the single-sled figure. What is the campaign total, in N?
w10_P4_001787: A 55,000 g trolley rolls at a speed in m/s equal to the greatest common divisor of 364 and 122. Its energy of motion, less 17 J of rolling loss, is the net energy per run. Nine runs are made, so the session energy is 9 times the net per-run value, and the session energy is then converted to kJ. The session lasted 45 minutes. The logger finally subtracts a 2 kJ reserve requirement, recording a negative value if the reserve is not met. What value does the logger record, in kJ?
w10_P4_001788: The final entry in a lab logbook, in kJ, is 8 times a per-trial figure. The per-trial figure is 20 J more than the energy of motion of a cart, with the sum then converted to kJ. The cart has a mass of 52 kg and moves at a speed in m/s equal to the area under the curve y = 1·x² + 2x between x = 2 and x = 3. The lab bench is 3 m long. What is the final entry, in kJ?
w10_P4_001790: The figure a bridge engineer finally quotes, in kN, is 10 times a single-jack figure. The single-jack figure is 20 kN of live-load allowance added to a subtotal, and the subtotal is 28 kN of dead-load allowance added to a jacking force expressed in kN. The jacking force is what is needed to accelerate a 160,000 g bearing plate at a rate in m/s² equal to the smaller root of x² - 10x + 21 = 0. What figure does the engineer quote, in kN?
w10_P4_001792: The total in a drone-motor report, in kN, is 8 times a per-drone figure. The per-drone figure is 2 times a single-motor thrust expressed in kN. A single motor supplies the force needed to accelerate a 3 kg test mass at a rate in m/s² equal to the smaller root of x² - 8x + 15 = 0. What total does the report give, in kN?
w10_P4_001795: A 56 kg cart on a factory test rail moves at a speed in m/s equal to the area under the curve y = 1·x² + 1·x between x = 0 and x = 3. Its energy of motion is reduced by 7 J of bearing loss and then by a further 15 J of air drag. The rail sits at a temperature of 19 °C. There are 8 carts per rail and 8 rails in the hall, so the hall total is the per-cart value multiplied by 8 and then by 8 again. What is the hall total, in J?
w10_P4_001799: A 28,000 g test block on a bench is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 1·x² + 7x between x = 1 and x = 2. The force needed for this is converted to kN. The bench log defines a net force as that value minus a 28 kN clamping force plus a 5 kN spring assist, with the driving direction positive, so the net can be negative. The bench is 2.2 m long. Three benches are combined, so the log multiplies the net force by 3. What does the log show, in kN?
w10_P4_001800: The total force a launch crew records, in N, is 11 times a single-booster figure. The single-booster figure is 8 N less than the force needed to accelerate a 55,000 g payload at a certain rate. That rate, in m/s², is the sum of 2k - 1 for k from 1 to 7, minus 5. What total does the crew record, in N?
w10_P4_001813: The figure at the end of a sled-test report is in kJ and is obtained by converting a net energy from J to kJ. The net energy is 25 J less than the combined energy of motion of 3 identical sleds. Each sled has a mass of 52,000 g and moves at a speed in m/s equal to the area under the curve y = 4x² + 7x between x = 2 and x = 3. What figure ends the report, in kJ?
w10_P4_001820: A 26,000 g projectile leaves a test launcher at a speed in m/s equal to 3 times the sum of 8 and 14. Its energy of motion is converted to kJ, and 28 kJ of launcher recoil loss is subtracted. The launcher barrel is 3 m long. Three launchers fire per volley and 7 volleys are fired, so the total is the per-shot value multiplied by 3 and then by 7. What is the total, in kJ?
w10_P4_001823: A 48,000 g racing sled reaches a speed in m/s found by taking the sum of the whole numbers from 1 to 15, subtracting 26, and then subtracting 23. Its energy of motion at that speed is measured. The timing system subtracts 1 J of gate loss from that measurement. It then subtracts a further 29 J of runner friction. What energy does the system report, in J?
w10_P4_001826: A 51,000 g cargo pod on a test sled moves at a speed in m/s equal to the number of ways to choose 2 items from a set of 9. Its energy of motion, less 29 J of runner loss, is converted to kJ. The sled track is 500 m long. Two pods are tested, so the report doubles the per-pod value. What does the report give, in kJ?
w10_P4_001827: An 85,000 g crate on a factory conveyor is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 1·x² + 4x between x = 2 and x = 4. Six identical drives each supply the force needed for this, and the controller sums the 6 outputs. It adds 15 N of belt tension and converts the total to kN. The conveyor runs at 40 °C. A 9 kN structural allowance is then added. What is the final value, in kN?
w10_P4_001830: The load figure a crane operator writes down, in kN, is 4 times a per-cable figure. The per-cable figure is a 25 kN preload added to a hoisting force that is expressed in kN. The hoisting force is what is needed to accelerate a 17 kg hook at a rate in m/s² equal to the greatest common divisor of 91 and 265. What load figure does the operator write down, in kN?
w10_P4_001833: The final thrust figure in a drone log, in N, is 1 N more than an adjusted figure. The adjusted figure is 18 N more than the force needed to accelerate a 13 kg drone at a certain rate. That rate, in m/s², is 28 more than the sum of the whole numbers from 1 to 8. What is the final thrust figure, in N?
w10_P4_001835: The total in a projectile-range report, in kJ, is 10 times a daily figure. The daily figure is 5 times a volley figure expressed in kJ. The volley figure is the combined energy of motion of 3 identical projectiles. Each projectile has a mass of 12 kg and flies at a speed in m/s equal to 4 times the sum of 7 and 5. The range is 900 m long. What is the total in the report, in kJ?
w10_P4_001836: A 38 kg tool head on a stamping machine is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to 2 times the sum of 4 and 12. The force required for this is converted to kN. Twelve identical heads act together, so the combined force is 12 times that value. The machine's stroke is 15 cm. The log records the combined force minus a 23 kN return-spring force, with the stamping direction positive, so the entry may be negative. What does the log record, in kN?
w10_P4_001837: A 199 kg beam is accelerated by a jack at a rate in m/s² equal to twice the greatest common divisor of 206 and 344. The jack must supply the force for this plus 17 N of seal friction. The beam is 4.5 m long. The total is converted to kN, and 28 kN of dead-load allowance is added. What is the resulting figure, in kN?
w10_P4_001839: A cyclist and bike with a combined mass of 48 kg ride on a velodrome at a speed in m/s equal to the larger root of x² - 7x + 10 = 0. A team of 8 such riders has a combined energy of motion 8 times that of one rider, and the coach converts that combined value to kJ. Three teams compete, so the meet figure is 3 times the team figure. Finally 23 kJ of stored reserve is added. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_001840: A 102,000 g sled is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to 16 more than the larger root of x² - 11x + 24 = 0. The thrust required for this, less 16 N contributed by a tailwind, is converted to kN. The sled track is 600 m long. Twelve sleds are launched together, so the total thrust is 12 times the single-sled value. What is the total thrust, in kN?
